sentences.en: That'sa mean-spirited thing for a mother to say.

sentences.en: And for very good if slightly mean-spirited reasons.

sentences.en: Mix this with personality quirks: Gossip, grudges, jealousies, mean-spirited behavior, lack of trust.

sentences.en: City growth proponents denounced their opponents as mean-spirited, power-hungry, and just plain stupid.

sentences.en: No more scoring mean-spirited points to show up the other side.

sentences.en: One stereotype that will never die is the dishonest and mean-spirited politician.
sentences.vi: Một khuôn mẫu sẽ không bao giờ chết là chính trị gia thiếu trung thực và hèn hạ.

sentences.en: To many,[http://sentencedict.com/meanspirited.html] his biting sense of humor comes off as mean-spirited rather than funny.

sentences.en: Now the old image of a mean-spirited Dole immediately resurfaces.
